summary:
Produced the 2×2 publication-quality figure (fig3_loss_curves.png and fig3_loss_curves.pdf) showing training dynamics for all four experimental conditions.

**Figure layout:**
- Rows: Seed 42 (top) / Seed 123 (bottom)
- Columns: No Augmentation (left) / Augmentation (right)
- Each panel: train_loss on left blue y-axis (#2166AC) + val_acc on right orange y-axis (#D6604D)
- Vertical grey dashed line at epoch=5 with "epoch 5" annotation
- Dot markers on both curves at epoch 5 with numerical value annotations
- Shared figure-level legend; super-title includes epoch-5 mean gap (−2.70 pp), regime classification (underfitting-penalty-confirmed), and no-crossover note

**Epoch-5 values plotted (spot-checked vs. combined_metrics.csv):**
- Seed 42 No-Aug:  loss=0.1879, val_acc=91.12%
- Seed 42 Aug:     loss=0.3761, val_acc=89.26%  (Δloss=+0.188, Δacc=−1.86 pp)
- Seed 123 No-Aug: loss=0.1880, val_acc=91.72%
- Seed 123 Aug:    loss=0.3738, val_acc=88.72%  (Δloss=+0.186, Δacc=−3.00 pp)

- figures/fig3_loss_curves.png exists ✓ (520 KB >> 30 KB threshold)
- figures/fig3_loss_curves.pdf exists ✓ (35.7 KB)
- PNG resolution: 3643×2385 px at 300 dpi ✓
- Image is not blank (pixel std > 0.01) ✓
